question: If in a coding system, SHELVES is coded as 1919515222219, and NOMINEE is coded as 1412131814225, then how will SEIZURE be coded in the same coding system?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

SHELVES is coded as 1919515222219

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aaacd8f4744709b4c8356e7c0a10233e2bc61bcf00e348b85765ff7ea6610d3.png] 

And,

NOMINEE is coded as 1412131814225

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b325205369a8a0bfd946adb12fa523a0b431bbe35ac2b5398dbe9649bdda698.png] 

Similarly,

**SEIZURE** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f1124cfb72a440b4cbc5f84c2371440759b5a15c64f9a7e366bada87984ff2.png] 

Hence, 'SEIZURE' is coded as "**1922912195**".
